en.name: Dark Noodle
en.description: Grows flexible whip-like constructs of nonliving matter from the user's body that can grab, swing, and lash at medium range. Activation converts the user's tissues into bundled, dark filament ropes that harden on command. The ropes are physical, not true energy, so they have reduced tensile strength and short duration and prolonged use exhausts the user.

en.name: Seamlash
en.description: The user is born with ringed dermal sockets that extrude semi-solid whip-tendons used to swing, anchor, and reel the body across medium distances. The tendons transmit sharp vibration and directional cues, granting extended spatial awareness along each lash. Tendons are stamina-draining and fragile compared to true constructs, with a short recovery after heavy use.

en.name: Repair Rope
en.description: Emits thin, manufactured tether-cords that harden on contact to brace, bind, or anchor objects and people, providing quick structural support. Cords unfurl from fingertip ports and can be tightened to steady or reposition targets within medium range. Heavy loads fray the cords and repeated use causes a short cooldown.

en.name: Arms That Go Through Walls And Punch
en.description: User temporarily converts limbs into semi-phased, extendable matter that can flow through open space and re-solidify as ultra-dense striking appendages at long range. Activation manifests as rippling translucence along limbs and a metallic clink on harden. Prolonged use causes severe limb numbness and a brief recovery cooldown.

en.name: Steelstep
en.description: Steelstep lets the user slide through solid matter by converting a touched surface into a temporary, semi‑rigid channel they can bore and ride. Activation requires direct touch and a deliberate push and grants acute tactile mapping of the interior structure. Extended use causes disorientation and a brief recovery period.

en.name: Hard Slip
en.description: User shifts into a semi-phased, hardened form that lets limbs slide a few meters through solid matter and deliver amplified, blunt strikes on contact. Activation shows a ridged, metallic sheen and gives short-range tactile sensing through surfaces. Causes brief vertigo and has a short cooldown.

en.name: Quick Bang
en.description: Emits combustible, sugar-rich vapor bursts that detonate in midair to deliver short, concussive shocks. The user exhales or forces syrupy droplets from their palms into a stream, then ignites the cloud to control blast size. Repeated use quickens metabolism and causes brief dizziness.

en.name: Fizzbang
en.description: The user emits a sugar-rich spray from their palms that can be ignited into short, fizzing explosions. Eating sugar amplifies output and turns the spray into volatile, popping droplets. Power peaks at close-to-medium range and heavy use causes a brief stamina crash.

en.name: Snack Bomb Shield
en.description: Expels sugary, nitro-like sweat as remote explosives that detonate at range to strike or push. By timing micro-detonations the user sculpts blast-pressured syrup into temporary shock-absorbing barriers. Overuse causes rapid hypoglycemia and fatigue.

en.name: Long Sticky Tongues That Shoot Bright Light
en.description: User temporarily sprouts dozens of adhesive, limb-like tongue constructs across a wide area; these stiffen into hollow channels that emit focused beams of light from their tips. Beams peak close to the user and weaken with distance. Sustained use causes dizziness and temporary tunnel vision.

en.name: Radiant Tongue
en.description: The user emits mucous-like bio-globules that instantly coat and form elastic, adhesive membranes over their tongue, hands, and forearms. A focused right-eye beam ionizes each globule to stiffen or relax the film on command. Prolonged firing causes severe eye strain and temporary blurred vision.

en.name: Glow Coat
en.description: The user emits a warm, bioluminescent mucous that spreads over their skin and hardens into a thin radiant film, accelerating tissue recovery and stabilizing body temperature. Droplets are fired from a small oral gland and only coat the user. Prolonged coverage causes mild overheating and light glare.

en.name: Sticky Suggestion Strings From His Elbows
en.description: Ejects adhesive ribbon constructs on direct touch that bind a target and enforce brief, simple compelled actions through patterned restraints. Ribbons form from the user's elbows and lace into sigil-like bands that emit the command while attached. Effects last seconds and repeated use causes nausea and a short cooldown.

en.name: Sticky Voice
en.description: Transforms the user's limbs into anthropomorphic adhesive appendages that extrude strong tape-like strips for gripping and restraining. The tape carries a low, repeating verbal pattern that nudges simple, instinctive mimicry in anyone held for several seconds. The influence is weak and short-lived, and prolonged use leaves the user dizzy and stiff.

en.name: Stick to It
en.description: Elbow-mounted adhesive ribbons extrude continuously and lock into sequential anchors that pull, reel, or swing the user's body for unusual self-propelled movement. Activation requires a low, involuntary chant that programs the ribbons' pull pattern. Prolonged chanting causes vocal fatigue and brief disorientation.
